# SoTech IT Solutions

> One Trusted Partner. Multiple Technology Solutions. A computer, laptop, phone and IT solutions store in Mile 12, Kosofe, Lagos, Nigeria.

Address: Adedoyin Complex, 12 Adedoyin Street, Mile 12, Kosofe, Lagos State, Nigeria

Website: https://www.sotechitsolutions.com.ng

## What we do
- [Products](https://www.sotechitsolutions.com.ng/products): new and quality UK-used laptops and phones, computer and phone accessories, cables, SSDs, hard drives, RAM, power banks, audio and gaming accessories, CCTV cameras
- [Services](https://www.sotechitsolutions.com.ng/services): laptop, desktop and phone repairs, Windows and Microsoft Office installation, SSD and RAM upgrades, maintenance, CCTV installation
- [Web & Digital Solutions](https://www.sotechitsolutions.com.ng/web-digital-solutions): website design, development and maintenance, domain registration, business email, email marketing
- [Coding & Design Academy](https://www.sotechitsolutions.com.ng/coding-academy): coding, computer literacy and design classes for children aged 6 to 16
- [Our Store](https://www.sotechitsolutions.com.ng/store): store location and directions
